description: Search icon references through the Exchange platform API (POST /v1/search/icons at api.openvibe.exchange, served by OpenVibe.AI). A first-party service holds only this route and its own free-search quota: no Exchange key, no inference, no web, image or fetch search. The receipt names the engine, the provider cost and each skipped attempt; results carry the icon set, author and licence. OpenVibe.Design uses it to show references beside a glyph draft.
